# No Pull Requests From Harness Branch

`catalyticarkun/spruceos-harness` is a working harness branch only.

Do not open pull requests from this branch into `Development`, `main`,
`upstream/Development`, or any `spruceUI/spruceOS` branch. The branch is allowed
to receive updates and push checkpoints to `origin` only.

If harness work needs to become mergeable later, create a separate review branch
from the desired base and copy or cherry-pick the approved commits there. This
branch itself must remain non-PR.
